SELECT B.CustomerID, B.ShareIndicator, C.AccountStatus, A.* FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD A
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount C ON C.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    AND B.CustomerID = 'R01870425' ORDER BY A.AccountID

SELECT B.CustomerID, B.ShareIndicator, C.AccountStatus, A.* FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD A
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount C ON C.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    AND B.CustomerID = 'R00186564'

SELECT B.CustomerID, B.ShareIndicator, C.AccountStatus, A.* FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON B.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount C ON C.AccountSK = A.AccountSK
    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    AND B.CustomerID = 'C00000768'

    WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = 20230601 AND B.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
